t: What Cell Behavior Database Is All About
title: What Cell Behavior Database Is All About
description: Cells sense and respond: white blood cells chase bacteria by chemotaxis, muscle cells contract on calcium signals, and stem cells choose fates by their neighbors' signals. The cell cycle runs G1-S-G2-M with checkpoints — p53 halts it on DNA damage. Apoptosis is programmed suicide: orderly self-dismantling that sculpts fingers from paddles in the embryo. This database is the complete cell behavior: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
